RefSTR(L) = 1 + floor(0.33 x (L - 1)) + floor((L - 1) / 2)

Mitigation = DP' / (DP' + RefAttack(Defender Level)) for DP' > 0; DP' / (RefAttack(Defender Level) - DP') for DP' < 0; 0 for DP' = 0
Raw Damage = Attack Power or Skill Power x (1 - Mitigation)
Weapon Scaling skills: Weapon Damage = main-hand Weapon Damage + off-hand item Damage x weight (1.0 elemental skills, 0.5 Physical skills; not heals, not Summon Turret; weapons_equipment 166)

Skill Potency Multiplier = 1 + INT / (200 + INT).

Skill Potency Bonus = Skill Potency Multiplier - 1.

Skill Potency does not apply to a Skill formula unless the Skill explicitly declares it.

Multi-hit basic attacks add each hit's distance and move the target once (USER RULING 2026-10-28). Multiplier = teamSize(n) / teamSize(max units per mission at send) x levelFactor x (1 + perkBonus). Worked out ONCE when the mission is sent and stored on the mission; a later Dispatch level-up never changes a mission that is out. Missions sent before this rule pay x1.
teamSize(n), n = units sent: 1.00 / 1.25 / 1.45 / 1.60 / 1.70 (5th step used at Dispatch L10), plus a reserved 6th step 1.75 for future perks. A full team always pays today's rate (normalisation N1).
levelFactor = clamp(1 - 0.04 x (average level of your top-n owned units - average level of the team sent), 0.60, 1.00); n = number of units sent; the top-n units include units away on Dispatch or in a dungeon; snapshot at send.
perkBonus = sum of the sent units' dispatch perks, clamped -30% .. +30%, with separate material and item values (unit_progression 109). No dispatch perks exist yet.
Applies to: materials = full multiplier; items on material missions = full multiplier; items on EXP missions = team size and perks only (no level factor). NOT applied to EXP or the weekly sulfur. The per-kind item safety cap of 10 stays.
